gbm_population_evidence.quote: WHO Grade 3 Glioma; WHO Grade 4 Glioma
History of World Health Organization (WHO) grade III or IV infiltrating glioma previously treated with first-line chemoradiotherapy.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Grade 3 and grade 4 glioma are both eligible and glioblastoma is never named; could be read as historical glioblastoma for the grade 4 patients.

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients receive Ga-68 PSMA-11 IV and then undergo PET/CT over 1 hour, 50-100 minutes after injection.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: MRI findings compatible with contrast-enhancing recurrent infiltrating glioma.

role_evidence.quote: An Investigational Scan (Ga-68 PSMA-11 PET/CT) for Detection of Disease Recurrence or Progression in Patients With Glioma

agents.drug_class_hint: gallium-68 labelled PSMA ligand PET imaging tracer

coder_notes: Diagnostic PET imaging study only; the sole drug is a Ga-68 tracer. Grade 3 and 4 glioma both eligible, GBM not named. Active moiety given as the INN gozetotide (gallium Ga 68 gozetotide is named in the detailed description).
